_about: SOC code prefixes whose work usually needs a license, registration or clearance; the longest matching prefix wins. A hint shown beside career suggestions, never an eligibility decision (careers.regulated).
29-1: Licensed health practitioner: a state license or registration is usually required
29-2: Health technician: certification or a state license is often required
53-3032: Heavy truck driver: a commercial driver's license (CDL) is required
53-2011: Pilot: an FAA certificate is required
47-2111: Electrician: a state or local license is usually required
47-2152: Plumber: a state or local license is usually required
33-: Protective service: background checks and often a license or certification are required
25-2: K-12 teacher: a state teaching certificate is usually required
39-5012: Cosmetologist: a state license is required
41-9022: Real estate agent: a state license is required
13-2011: Accountant: CPA licensure is required for some roles
